title: Signature Gaze Dwell Detection
description: Signature Gaze Dwell Detection is a focus-tracking ability in the Signature Biometric Focus Tracking database. Detects when the eyes rest on one element long enough to signal real attention. Fixations are clustered from the raw gaze stream; a dwell is declared when the cluster radius stays under 1 degree for the dwell threshold. It takes gaze point stream and produces dwell events with target element. Tunable parameters: dwell threshold 300–1200 ms. Guarantee: dwells shorter than the threshold are never reported. This record is a Signature-authored completion — an original design of the JAH system, clearly labeled Signature, and not presented as a harvested public record.

title: Signature Heart-Rate Load Index
description: Signature Heart-Rate Load Index is a focus-tracking ability in the Signature Biometric Focus Tracking database. Turns heart-rate variability into a live cognitive-load score. Inter-beat intervals are windowed and the RMSSD is normalized against the user's resting baseline to produce a 0–1 load score. It takes PPG or ECG stream, resting baseline and produces load score 0–1. Tunable parameters: window 30–120 s. Guarantee: the score never uses another person's baseline. This record is a Signature-authored completion — an original design of the JAH system, clearly labeled Signature, and not presented as a harvested public record.

title: Signature Posture Shift Counting

Tunable parameters: variance threshold tuned per device. Guarantee: a single continuous motion counts once, not repeatedly. title: Signature Blink-Rate Fatigue Watch
description: Signature Blink-Rate Fatigue Watch is a focus-tracking ability in the Signature Biometric Focus Tracking database. Watches blink rate for the rise that precedes fatigue. Tunable parameters: alert if rate rises 50% over baseline. Guarantee: flags require 3 consecutive elevated minutes. title: Signature Attention Heat Overlay
description: Signature Attention Heat Overlay is a focus-tracking ability in the Signature Biometric Focus Tracking database. Paints a live heat map of where attention has been over the last minute. Tunable parameters: grid 24×16, decay half-life 20 s. Guarantee: stale attention fades below 1% within two minutes. title: Signature Multi-Signal Fusion
